cohort: A 30-year-old pregnant woman diagnosed with type B aortic dissection at 29 weeks of gestation.
finding: This case illustrates that acute aortic dissection in pregnancy can be the initial presentation of Marfan syndrome, emphasizing the need for comprehensive patient history and a multidisciplinary approach.
mod_finding: A cesarean section was performed at 29 weeks and six days due to uncontrolled hypertension and persistent pain, after evaluating maternal and fetal risk-benefit.
